You just closed a $15M seed round to build the definitive RWA Layer 1 — that's exactly the kind of ambition we love at Aurora Pathways. With your testnet live and mainnet on the horizon, you'll need battle-tested Solidity contracts for asset tokenization (ERC-3643 for compliant securities, ERC-20 wrappers), on-chain verification oracles, and a governance framework for your validator set. We can ship the full smart contract stack — tokenization modules, compliance checks, and DAO governance — all in Foundry with 100% test coverage, so your team stays focused on the protocol layer. Would you be open to a 20-minute call to review your contract roadmap?

$16.25M Pre-A, building cross-chain DeFi money markets on Monad — this is a serious build. Your cross-chain lending brokerage and institutional yield products need airtight smart contracts that handle multi-chain collateral, liquidation logic, and yield distribution without introducing attack vectors. Aurora Pathways can develop your lending pool contracts, cross-chain bridge adapters, and yield strategy vaults in Solidity/Foundry, with formal verification-ready code and comprehensive test suites. We've delivered 10/10 passing tests on our reference ERC-20 and can apply the same rigor to your money market contracts. I'd love to discuss how we can accelerate your mainnet deployment.

Congrats on the $3M pre-seed from Lemniscap — trustless on-chain prop trading on Hyperliquid is a genuinely cool use case. You're building a protocol where traders access up to $200K in funded accounts with automated profit splits — that means your smart contracts need to handle capital allocation, P&L tracking, and instant payouts without a single wei of slippage. Aurora Pathways can build your core trading vault contracts, profit-split logic, and automated settlement module in Solidity, with full Foundry test coverage and gas optimization. We can deliver a complete audit-ready contract suite so you can focus on trader acquisition. Want to hop on a call this week?

You're the leader in liquid staking and you're hunting for a Smart Contract Lead at $240-300K — which tells me you've got more protocol work than your current team can handle. While you run the search, Aurora Pathways can step in as an embedded smart contract team: we build in Solidity/Foundry, write comprehensive test suites, and can tackle your overflow — whether it's new staking derivatives, validator infrastructure contracts, or upgrade migrations. We've shipped ERC-20, ERC-721, and DAO governance contracts with 10/10 passing tests, and we understand the security stakes of a protocol that custodies real assets. I'd be happy to share code samples and discuss how we can keep your roadmap moving while you find the right permanent hire.

CoW Protocol is doing some of the most interesting work in MEV protection and intent-based trading, and I see you're hiring a Smart Contract Engineer to expand the ecosystem. With CoW Swap, CoW AMM, and MEV Blocker all needing ongoing contract development, Aurora Pathways can augment your team with Solidity/Foundry expertise — whether it's new solver incentives, AMM pool logic, or gas-optimized order-matching contracts. We deliver production-grade code with full test suites and can ramp up in days, not months. Would you be open to a conversation about how we can support the CoW DAO grants program or core protocol work?

Congrats on the $8M raise — building programmable stablecoin rails for institutions across Africa and LATAM is exactly the kind of infrastructure the market needs right now. With exchanges, OTC desks, and payment providers all plugging into Checker, your smart contract layer needs to handle multi-party settlement, compliance-gated transfers, and cross-chain stablecoin swaps without introducing counterparty risk. Aurora Pathways can build your core settlement contracts, institutional compliance modules, and swap routing logic in Solidity/Foundry with audit-ready test coverage. We've shipped ERC-20 and governance contracts with 10/10 passing tests and can ramp up immediately. Would you be open to a 20-minute call to discuss your contract roadmap?

The USDat protocol is one of the most interesting stablecoin designs I've seen — backing a yield-bearing stablecoin with MicroStrategy's STRC and routing it through Chainlink CCIP is a serious architecture play. With $60M+ TVL already, your two-token system (USDat + sUSDat vault) needs battle-tested smart contracts for minting, redemption, yield distribution, and the 3-7 day withdrawal queue. Aurora Pathways can develop and audit your core vault contracts, yield accrual logic, and cross-chain distribution modules in Solidity/Foundry — we deliver production-grade code with comprehensive test suites. Would love to discuss how we can support the protocol as you scale past mainnet launch.

Totalis is solving a real gap in prediction markets — multi-leg parlays with unified liquidity across categories is a compelling product vision, and being YC's first all-USDC investment puts you on everyone's radar. With parlays spanning geopolitics, crypto, and sports, your Solana contracts need to handle multi-leg position creation, automated settlement across disparate oracle feeds, and liquidity pool management — all with sub-second finality requirements. Aurora Pathways can build your core parlay contracts, oracle integration layer, and settlement logic with full test coverage. We specialize in shipping production Solidity fast and can help you hit your go-live timeline. Want to hop on a quick call?

Colizeum's SDK-first approach to Web3 gaming is smart — making it dead simple for Unity and Unreal devs to add tokenized economies without hiring a blockchain team is a real value prop. As you scale to more game studios, your contract layer needs to handle high-throughput ERC-1155 minting for in-game assets, staking pools for play-to-earn rewards, and tournament prize distribution contracts — all optimized for gas efficiency across multiple chains. Aurora Pathways can build your core NFT minting infrastructure, reward distribution contracts, and staking mechanics in Solidity/Foundry with full test coverage. We'd love to discuss how we can help you onboard more studios faster. Free for a call this week?
